responsibilities: ► Love Lawn Service — Agriculture ERP (App Store & Google Play) | Team size: 8 | 06/2025 – 01/2026

Built a dual-role on-demand lawn care platform (React Native + Expo) for customers (booking, real-time job tracking, payment) and field workers (GPS check-in, photo upload, incident reporting, time tracking).
Integrated Helcim payment gateway via WebView/JS Bridge, handling checkout session, real-time event messaging, and transaction persistence.
Implemented real-time 1-on-1 chat (Socket.IO) between customer, worker, and admin roles.
Implemented push notifications (expo-notifications + expo-server-sdk) including a scheduled notification system (node-cron).
Managed GPS-based worker check-in (expo-location + MapLibre maps) and photo uploads (BEFORE/AFTER/MATERIAL/INCIDENT) to AWS S3.
Contributed to RESTful APIs documented with Swagger UI (Node.js + Prisma): worker assignment, payment/invoice pipeline (20+ Prisma models).
Generated PDF invoices (PDFKit) and email notifications (nodemailer); secured API with JWT, bcrypt, helmet, rate-limiting, and Zod validation.
Dockerized backend + admin-web; configured docker-compose stack (PostgreSQL 15, Redis 7, Nginx, pgadmin) and GitHub Actions CI/CD for auto-deploy to VPS.
Deployed mobile app via EAS Build to App Store and Google Play.
► VIET PLUS — Multi-category Classifieds Super App | Team size: 6 | 10/2025 – 05/2026
Built a multi-category classifieds super app (React Native + Expo) with 10+ feature modules targeting Vietnamese expat communities.
Developed listing flows for 6 categories: new/used items, vehicles, housing rentals, job postings, ride-sharing, and an online marketplace (smarket).
Integrated real-time 1-on-1 chat (Socket.IO + @socket.io/redis-adapter) for Redis-backed horizontal scaling, linked directly to listings.
Implemented shopping cart, order management, and payment flow; state management with Redux Toolkit (18 slices) + redux-persist.
Contributed to RESTful APIs documented with Swagger UI (Node.js + Prisma): listing CRUD, order processing, user profile, report & block, chat, notification modules (21 route modules).
Set up dual CI/CD pipeline: GitHub Actions + GitLab CI for auto build → Docker Hub → SSH deploy to VPS.
Deployed mobile app via EAS Build to App Store and Google Play.
► Homenest Software & Homenest Vietnam — Corporate Websites | Team size: 4 | 05/2026 – 07/2026
Developed two multilingual corporate websites (EN + VI), 20+ pages each, using Next.js 16 App Router and CSS Modules component-based architecture.
Integrated headless WordPress CMS via GraphQL API for dynamic content management (case studies, wiki, industries, services).
Implemented comprehensive SEO: generateMetadata per page, JSON-LD Schema.org (Corporation, Organization, 18-service OfferCatalog, ContactPoint), OpenGraph, Twitter Card.
Integrated @splinetool/react-spline for 3D interactive UI elements; implemented Dynamic Routing and 14 permanent 301 redirect rules to preserve SEO during migration.
Set up GitHub Actions CI/CD → GitHub Container Registry (ghcr.io) with SHA-tagged Docker images and SSH auto-deploy to VPS.

clientFAQs.question: What types of projects does your freelance team handle?
clientFAQs.answer: We deliver a wide range of digital solutions, including corporate websites, personal portfolios, landing pages, full-scale mobile apps (iOS/Android), and custom web/app systems tailored to specific business needs.

clientFAQs.question: How does the payment process work for freelance projects?
clientFAQs.answer: We offer two flexible models: Fixed-price for projects with clearly defined scopes, and Milestone-based payment, where you pay progressively as we complete and deliver agreed-upon phases of the project.

clientFAQs.question: What does the project handover process look like?
clientFAQs.answer: We ensure a transparent 3-step handover: User Acceptance Testing (UAT) on the beta version, complete transfer of all digital assets (Source Code, Database, App Store/Google Play accounts), and hands-on training to help you operate the system confidently.

clientFAQs.question: Do you offer post-launch maintenance and support?
clientFAQs.answer: Absolutely. After the handover, we provide a committed maintenance period to resolve any technical issues, ensure server stability, and support your team in running the application smoothly.

titles.desc_experience: As a Full Stack and Mobile Developer, I specialize in providing professional website design services and cross-platform mobile app development. I am committed to delivering high-performance technology solutions with stunning UI/UX designs, helping your business optimize user experience and increase conversion rates.

hrFAQs.question: Why use both React Native and Flutter?
hrFAQs.answer: I choose the tech stack based on project requirements. React Native is ideal when sharing business logic with web platforms (Next.js), while Flutter is my go-to for rendering complex UIs and smooth animations.

hrFAQs.question: How do you handle Full-stack development efficiently?
hrFAQs.answer: My approach is architecture-first. I design databases and write Swagger UI docs to lock down data flows before building UIs. Additionally, I leverage CI/CD pipelines (Codemagic, GitHub Actions) to automate deployments.

hrFAQs.question: How do you optimize app performance and prevent memory leaks?
hrFAQs.answer: I strictly manage the App Life-cycle. For instance, I integrated Socket.IO directly into RTK Query and managed WebSocket connections based on screen mounts/unmounts. This eliminates memory leaks and ensures a stable 60FPS.

hrFAQs.question: How do you collaborate within an Agile/Scrum team?
hrFAQs.answer: I believe in communicating through processes and documentation. Tracking tasks in Jira, reviewing code via Git PRs, and maintaining up-to-date Swagger UI docs ensures the Mobile, Web, and Backend teams stay perfectly synced.

hrFAQs.question: What are your career goals for the next 1-2 years?
hrFAQs.answer: To grow as a T-shaped Engineer: deeply specializing in Cross-platform Mobile & Performance Optimization, while expanding my Cloud infrastructure skills (currently studying for AWS) to independently architect and deploy scalable systems.
